An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV decode process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

A vulnerability in the Yoda'a Crytper (yC) Portable Executable (PE) unpacker of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device. .
 This vulnerability is due to lack of proper error checking for negative values when processing the PE file to be unpacked. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a PE file to be unpacked. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

A vulnerability in the InstallShield file parser of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to incomplete error checking when the InstallShield File Parser is performing a scan. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted InstallShield file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate due to an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

A vulnerability in the LZX data algorithm for Microsoft Compiled HTML Help (CHM) file scanning in ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to improper boundary checks when applying the LZX data algorithm to CHM files during the decoder stage, which may result in buffer overflow. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted CHM file for scanning. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

A vulnerability in the debug logging functionality of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to improper handling of logging values. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a file to be scanned by the software that has debug logging enabled. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

HomeBox is a home inventory and organization system. Prior to 0.27.0, the unauthenticated GET /swagger/doc.json endpoint copies the client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host header into the OpenAPI host field without requiring a trusted proxy or validating the value. An attacker can therefore make the served OpenAPI document direct Swagger UI Try it out requests to an attacker-controlled host. When a shared cache or CDN stores and serves that poisoned document to an authenticated user, Swagger UI sends the user's API requests and bearer token to the attacker, enabling disclosure and modification of the user's HomeBox data. Without a shared cache, the attacker can affect only the attacker's own response. This issue is fixed in version 0.27.0.

A vulnerability in the Ultimate Packer for eXecutables (UPX) unpacker of ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.   This vulnerability is due to improper length checks, when unpacking the UPX files, which may result in an out-of-bounds read of heap memory. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by submitting a crafted UPX for decode. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to cause the ClamAV decode process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

A vulnerability in the Object Linking and Embedding, 2nd Generation (OLE2) file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to exceed the configured MaxScanTime and cause a DoS condition on an affected device.   This vulnerability is due to inefficiencies when parsing specifically formatted files with the OLE2 file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted Microsoft Compound File Binary (CFB) file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to effectively cause the ClamAV OLE2 parser to get into an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

Rucio is a scientific data management framework. From 1.14.0 until 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1, validate_auth_token in lib/rucio/core/authentication.py does not distinguish short-lived SSH challenge nonces from authentication tokens stored in the same token table. An unauthenticated attacker can request /auth/ssh_challenge_token for an arbitrary account by supplying X-Rucio-Account, then present the returned X-Rucio-SSH-Challenge-Token as X-Rucio-Auth-Token to authenticate to other API endpoints as that account, including an administrative account. This issue is fixed in versions 35.9.1, 38.6.1, 40.4.2, and 41.1.1.

tiny-secp256k1 is a tiny secp256k1 native/JS wrapper. From 2.1.0 until 2.2.5 for tiny-secp256k1 and from 2.2.2 until 2.2.5 for @bitcoin-js/tiny-secp256k1-asmjs, the three-argument xOnlyPointAddTweakCheck path ignores the backend failure return from xOnlyPointAddTweak when a tweak produces the point at infinity. The shared X_ONLY_PUBLIC_KEY_INPUT buffer then still contains the original point, so a caller-controlled resultToCheck equal to that point can make the stale-buffer comparison return true even though no tweaked key exists. Protocols that rely on this helper to validate caller-controlled internal keys, tweaks, and comparison values can accept an invalid derived key. This issue is fixed in version 2.2.5.

A vulnerability in Object Linking and Embedding, 2nd Generation (OLE2) file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause a DoS condition on an affected device.
 This vulnerability is due to logic error when parsing specifically formatted files with the OLE2 file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted Microsoft Compound File Binary (CFB) file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to allocate all available memory, causing the ClamAV scanning process to terminate, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

libp2p is a JavaScript implementation of the libp2p networking stack. Prior to 17.0.0, the @libp2p/gossipsub default configuration allows a connected remote peer to submit unsigned subscription RPC metadata for arbitrarily many distinct topic strings. handleReceivedSubscription in packages/gossipsub/src/gossipsub.ts creates a persistent topics-map entry for each accepted topic, while allowedTopics is unset by default, decodeRpc maxSubscriptions limits only one RPC rather than aggregate topic bytes, and peer scoring has no subscription-volume penalty. A single peer can therefore grow the topics map and committed heap toward out-of-memory conditions, and disconnecting additionally causes removePeer to scan all accumulated topic entries. This issue is fixed in version 17.0.0.

k8s-mcp-server manages Kubernetes clusters through the Model Context Protocol. Prior to 1.1.0, SERVER_MODE defaults to SSE, with the listener on 0.0.0.0:8080, but main.go creates the SSE server without an authentication option or context function. The GET /sse handler creates a sessionId that is only a correlation value, and the POST /message handler accepts a loadable sessionId without an authorization or Origin check before dispatching tools/call; consequently, any client able to reach the port can enumerate and invoke registered Kubernetes tools without credentials. Read-only mode is disabled by default, leaving write-capable Kubernetes tools available to run with the server's configured cluster privileges. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.0.

Filament Curator is a media picker plugin for Filament panels. From 3.0.0 until 3.7.9, 4.1.2, and 5.1.2, the Curator media panel accepts image/svg+xml files by default and stores and serves their markup inline without sanitization. An authenticated user with media-upload permission can store an SVG containing scripts, event-handler attributes, or javascript: URIs. When another panel user selects the View action, the SVG opens as a top-level browser document and its active content executes in the Filament application's origin. The script can perform authenticated same-origin actions as the viewing user and read same-origin data and script-accessible tokens. Panel thumbnails are not affected because they render through an image element that does not execute SVG script. This issue is fixed in versions 3.7.9, 4.1.2, and 5.1.2.

NUUO NVRmini 2 through 3.0.8 contains a file disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read web-root files by passing a filename to the 'css' parameter of css_parser.php. Attackers can retrieve PHP source files confined to the document root, exposing hardcoded credentials and sensitive application logic. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

Tiny Tiny RSS before commit c68ac04 (2019-03-03) contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users through the unvalidated 'return' parameter. Attackers can craft requests to /public.php?op=login with an absolute external URL in 'return', which is placed in the Location header to send victims to attacker-controlled sites. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-02-26.

Kiwi TCMS before 8.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the User.filter JSON-RPC method that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve user account information. Attackers can send a POST request to /json-rpc/ invoking User.filter with a query parameter to disclose sensitive user data without authentication. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

OpenSNS 3.2.1 contains an unauthenticated code injection vulnerability in the shareBox method of ShareController that allows attackers to invoke arbitrary model methods via the query parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to /index.php?s=weibo/Share/shareBox abusing parse_str and ShareModel::getInfo to reach Schedule::runSchedule and execute code through assert. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

MeterSphere versions 1.13.0 before 1.14.7 and 1.15.0 before 1.16.4 contain a pre-authentication code injection vulnerability due to the /plugin/** endpoints being exposed with anonymous access. Attackers can upload a malicious jar via POST /plugin/add and invoke it through POST /plugin/customMethod using the 'entry' and 'request' parameters, which are passed to Class.forName and method invocation for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Teable is an AI spreadsheet for business. Prior to release.2026-07-21T11-27-40Z.2320, a registered user can supply path traversal sequences in the hash field accepted by POST /api/attachments/signature when the default local storage provider is in use. In apps/nestjs-backend/src/features/attachments/plugins/local.ts, LocalStorage.presigned uses the client-controlled hash as the storage filename, and LocalStorage.save resolves that path and copies the uploaded request body without calling assertPathWithinStorage on the write path. The read path uses the jail, but the write path does not, allowing the resolved destination to escape the configured storage directory. Because the backend container runs as uid 0, the attacker can write or overwrite arbitrary root-owned files, which can corrupt the instance or lead to root code execution. Object-storage deployments that do not use LocalStorage.save are not affected by this sink. This issue is fixed in release.2026-07-21T11-27-40Z.2320.
Dell PowerStore SDNAS contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability that could allow an attacker with internal network access to execute arbitrary commands as root on the NAS node.

BizPrint (print-google-cloud-print-gcp-woocommerce) before 4.10.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in its Debug\Core component that allows any authenticated user, including the lowest-privilege Subscriber role, to invoke the getPrinters and sendPrintRequest AJAX actions without a nonce or capability check. Attackers can send a crafted admin-ajax.php request with an arbitrary WooCommerce order_id to dispatch print jobs for other customers' orders and disclose printer configuration, exposing cross-customer PII and abusing printer resources.
vp: bizprint – automatic order printing for woocommerce

cves.d: The Chainguard SDK is a public Go SDK for integrating with the Chainguard platform. Prior to 0.1.107, auth/aws.VerifyToken trusts the Chainguard-Audience and Chainguard-Identity headers without requiring those headers to be covered by AWS SigV4 SignedHeaders. An attacker with a fresh STS GetCallerIdentity request signed by a victim can rewrite the unsigned binding headers and replay the proof to another relying party, causing the relying party to authenticate the victim’s AWS identity for an attacker-chosen audience and identity. Code that only uses auth/aws.GenerateToken is unaffected because the generator signs the binding headers, and exploitation requires a signed request within its validity window. This issue is fixed in version 0.1.107.

Linux Mint Update Manager manages software updates on Linux Mint systems. From 5.4.8 until 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1, mint-refresh-cache passes a user-controlled --parent-window-id value directly to the privileged Synaptic process without validating it as an integer. A local user permitted to execute mint-refresh-cache through sudo can inject additional Synaptic command-line options and achieve arbitrary code execution as root. This issue is fixed in versions 5.5.4.3, 5.5.9.1, 5.8.8.1, 5.9.8.1, 6.0.9.1, and 6.1.5.1.

The ICRTouch white-label TouchTakeaway Cordova applications do not implement certificate or public-key pinning for backend HTTPS connections. The applications therefore rely exclusively on the device’s system trust store when validating server certificates.
An attacker who can cause a device to trust an attacker-controlled certificate authority, or who operates through a compromised or improperly issued trusted certificate, may be able to intercept and modify application traffic.

Virtual Keyboard plugin for SquirrelMail through 0.9.1 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script by supplying unsanitized input in the passformname parameter. Attackers can craft GET requests to /plugins/vkeyboard/vkeyboard.php with script payloads in passformname to execute code in victims' browsers and steal session cookies. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

SLiMS Senayan Library Management System 9.4.0 before 9.4.2 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in the destination parameter of /index.php?p=member, which is echoed unmodified into the login form action attribute. Unauthenticated attackers can craft a malicious destination value to inject script and hijack PHPSESSID sessions of victims who access the link. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

nginxWebUI 3.0.0 before 3.5.8 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach the /AdminPage/conf/runCmd endpoint by using a case-variant path that evades the case-sensitive /adminPage/ login filter. Attackers can pass OS commands through the cmd parameter, which are executed via /bin/sh with insufficient filtering of & and $() characters, achieving remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Bagisto 2.1.0 before 2.2.1 contains a client-side template injection vulnerability in the search page where the 'query' parameter is rendered unescaped inside a Vue app root. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted VueJS template expressions to the /bagisto-common/search endpoint via the 'query' parameter to execute arbitrary JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

Camunda 7.24.0 before 7.24.14 and 7.23.0 before 7.23.17 contains an XML External Entity (XXE) injection vulnerability in the camunda-external-task-client's DomXmlDataFormat.defaultDocumentBuilderFactory(), which fails to disable external entity resolution when parsing object variables serialized with application/xml. An attacker able to write a process variable can trigger arbitrary file read and out-of-band outbound HTTP requests from every worker JVM that deserializes the variable, enabling exfiltration of credentials, service-account tokens, and private key material from network segments deeper than the engine itself.

Vvveb before 1.0.9.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in generateCookie() in system/user/user.php that uses loose comparison to validate MD5 cookie hashes. Unauthenticated attackers can brute-force cookie values until the server's MD5 computation yields a 0e magic hash, then forge persistent cookies for account takeover.

Dagu 1.23.0 before 2.0.0 defaults auth.mode to none, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute OS commands through the /api/v2/dag-runs endpoint. Attackers can send a POST request with an inline spec defining steps containing arbitrary shell commands to achieve remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-03-11.

Vvveb 1.0.8.4 through 1.0.8.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the content/revisions revision action that lets low-privileged Authors read other authors' revisions. Attackers can supply a post_id, language_id, and created_at timestamp to retrieve private unpublished drafts, because the revision() action lacks the admin_id ownership restriction.

The Magic Login Mail or QR Code plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation via Administrator Account Takeover in versions up to, and including, 2.07. This is due to the `curpageurl()` function falling back to the raw `$_SERVER['HTTP_HOST']` value — with no validation against the site's configured origin via `home_url()` or `site_url()` — when `get_the_permalink()` returns empty or false, allowing an attacker-controlled Host header to become the URL origin of the magic-login link generated by `generate_url()` and delivered to the target via `wp_mail()`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to intercept the one-time uid and token pair sent to a targeted Administrator's email and replay them against the real site, causing `autologin_via_url()` to call `wp_set_auth_cookie()` and establish a full Administrator session on the targeted account. Exploitation requires the `[magic_login]` shortcode to render on a path where `get_the_permalink()` returns empty or false (such as a 404 page or a block-theme header template part), the web server to forward non-canonical Host headers, the attacker to know the target administrator's email address, and the administrator to click the attacker-originated magic-login link. Successful exploitation gives the attacker control of a distinct, already-privileged Administrator account; it does not promote the attacker's original account. Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
vp: magic login mail or qr code

cves.d: Weblate 2026.11 through 2026.11.2 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in the GET /api/tasks/{pk}/ endpoint that exposes unredacted repository error messages. Authenticated project members lacking vcs.view permission can poll failing repository tasks to obtain RepositoryCommandError text revealing upstream repository URLs, filesystem paths, and host names.

Vvveb through 1.0.8.6 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows low-privilege author or vendor users to inject script by bypassing the regex blacklist in sanitizeHTML(). Attackers can save post or product content with unclosed event-handler tags or javascript: entities to execute script for anonymous visitors and admins, enabling session or CSRF-token theft.

PMB 7.3.1 before 7.3.15 and 7.4.x before 7.4.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script through unescaped POST parameter names. Attackers can send crafted parameter names to opac_css/index.php extended_search, which empr.inc.php and languages.inc.php reflect into hidden form inputs to execute JavaScript. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Dockhand before 1.0.55 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that lets users holding only containers:view download arbitrary container files instead of requiring containers:exec. Authenticated Enterprise RBAC users can request any path from the files/download endpoint, which reads through Docker's archive API, to retrieve secrets, keys, and mounted credentials.

Xibo CMS before 4.5.3 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other DataSets' RSS feeds by pairing their own DataSet id with a foreign RSS id. Attackers with dataset.modify permission can read, edit, or delete feeds and steal PSKs, then use the unauthenticated /rss/{psk} endpoint to exfiltrate victim DataSet rows.

Frappe HRMS from 16.0.0 before 16.20.1 contains an information exposure vulnerability that places the subscription key in the query string of outbound subscription status requests. Attackers with access to proxy, server, or monitoring logs along the request path can recover the site's subscription key from recorded URLs.

Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.

OpenBao before 2.6.5 and 2.7.x before 2.7.2, and the openbao-plugins LDAP and RADIUS auth plugins before 0.2.0, contain an ACL bypass in the AppRole, Cert, LDAP, and RADIUS auth methods caused by implicit path canonicalization. Authenticated attackers can request non-canonical paths for AppRole Role IDs, Cert CRLs, LDAP groups and users, or RADIUS users to evade ACL deny rules.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.4.

The web dashboard in Coder 2.24.0 before 2.29.23, 2.30.0 before 2.34.14, 2.35.0 before 2.36.9, 2.37.0 before 2.37.6, and 2.38.0 before 2.38.2 replaces the $SESSION_TOKEN placeholder in external app URLs with a full-access API key without checking whether the app belongs to a sub-agent. Code running in a workspace can register a disguised sub-agent app with a custom protocol URL, so the owner's click sends their API key to an attacker-chosen destination.

Flagr before 1.2.5 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access the flag management write API through an insecure default FLAGR_BASIC_AUTH_WHITELIST_PATHS including /api/v1/flags. Because basicAuth.whitelist() in pkg/config/middleware.go matches only path prefixes regardless of HTTP method, attackers can create, modify, enable, disable, and delete flags, variants, segments, constraints, and distributions.

react-native-webview 11.25.1 through 17.1.0 on Android contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows web content to crash the host application via malformed Content-Disposition headers. Attackers can serve a download whose filename* parameter has invalid percent-encoding, triggering an uncaught IllegalArgumentException in URLUtil.parseContentDisposition on the main thread to terminate the app.

Coyote before commit d6e8fb9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in Wiki\CommentController::save that allows authenticated users to edit other users' wiki comments. Attackers can send POST requests to /Comment/Save/{wiki}/{id} with another user's comment id, bypassing the WikiCommentPolicy update check, so altered text appears under the original author's name.

Pytition before 2.10 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the show_signatures view that allows registered users to delete other petitions' signatures by supplying foreign signature IDs. Attackers can post sequential signature IDs to their own petition's signatures page to permanently delete signatures from any user-owned petition and trigger confirmation emails to other signers.

Scalar scalar-ninja 0.1.0 before 0.3.3 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject scripts by supplying unescaped ScalarConfig title values. Attackers controlling title metadata can close the title element with </title> and inject a script tag that executes in the documentation origin for API reference visitors.

GreaterWMS through 2.1.54 contains a predictable authentication token vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge openid tokens by recomputing an unsalted MD5 hash of username and registration timestamp. Attackers who know a username and can bound its registration time can brute-force candidate openid values in the Token header to gain full read and write access to warehouse, staff, customer, supplier and order data.

HomeBox is a home inventory and organization system. Prior to 0.27.0, a HomeBox password change revokes the user's other session tokens but does not revoke the user's API keys, and API keys have no default API-key expiration. An attacker who has obtained an API key can therefore retain full API-level access after the account owner changes the password and can keep that access indefinitely unless the owner discovers and manually deletes the key by ID. Because the password change terminates other sessions, the surviving API credential can evade the owner's expected containment and detection. This issue is fixed in version 0.27.0.

The ownCloud Desktop Client synchronizes files between an ownCloud server and a desktop. Prior to 6.0.2, an authenticated attacker can share a specially crafted file with a victim. If the file is synced by the client and revealed in the macOS Finder, it can cause operating-system command injection on the victim’s computer. This issue is fixed in version 6.0.2.

phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows attackers holding a hijacked session to enroll passkeys using only the session and webauthn CSRF token. Attackers can call /api/webauthn/prepare and /api/webauthn/register to replace the owner's passkeys, gaining persistent passwordless login that survives password changes and resets.

Forge, also called node-forge, is a native implementation of Transport Layer Security in JavaScript. Prior to 1.4.1, publicKey.verify() with the default RSASSA-PKCS1-V1_5 scheme in lib/rsa.js parses the recovered DigestInfo with the lenient BER parser asn1.fromDer() and validates its structure with digestInfoValidator without requiring canonical DER bytes. Non-minimal or indefinite lengths, malformed parameter values, and non-canonical object identifier encodings with padded subidentifiers or trailing bytes can leave attacker-controlled data inside an accepted DigestInfo. When the verifying RSA public key uses a low exponent such as e=3, an attacker can use that encoding slack to forge a signature without the private key. The same path is used by X.509 certificate and PKCS#7 signature verification. This issue is fixed in version 1.4.1.

WPS Limit Login (wps-limit-login) before 1.5.9.5 contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass login lockout protections by keying the per-attempt login counter and lockout map on the raw, non-canonicalized IPv6 client address. Attackers controlling a routable IPv6 /64 prefix can send each login attempt from a fresh address within that range, preventing any counter from reaching the lockout threshold and enabling effectively unlimited brute-force password guessing against WordPress accounts.

The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and including, 8.7.7 The public penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action feeds infeedads[ads_code] (base64+urldecoded) to penci_safe_shortcode(), whose allowlist regex inspects only the hyphen-truncated outer shortcode name (e.g. 'adinserter') and never the nested [elementor-element k=.. data=..] tag, so do_shortcode() renders an attacker-chosen Elementor element. The rendered penci-featured-sliders widget passes its unsanitized 'style' setting to include dirname(__FILE__)."/{$style}.php", a path-traversal local file inclusion.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a stored sql injection vulnerability in the MySQL driver that allows database users with table creation rights to inject SQL through unescaped geometry column names in unconvert_field(). Attackers can craft a column name containing an SQL expression that executes with another AdminNeo user's privileges when they edit a row, save it, or export the table.

wishthis through 1.2.3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the PUT branch of src/api/wishes.php that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify wish URLs across all users. Attackers who know a wish link from a public wishlist can supply wish_url_current and wish_url_proposed parameters to redirect owners and gift-givers to attacker-controlled URLs.

Dolibarr ERP CRM through 24.0.3 contains a code injection vulnerability in Website::importWebSite() that allows website editors without PHP permission to execute code by importing templates. Attackers can import a template zip whose javascript.js.php contains PHP code, which the public javascript.js.php endpoint includes, executing code as the web server user.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in UX-themes Flatsome flatsome allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Flatsome: from n/a before 3.20.13.

HyperFrames before 0.8.216 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the engine URL downloader because isBlockedHost() only checks IP literals and never resolves DNS host names. Attackers can supply compositions with remote media, image or font URLs whose host names resolve to private addresses, making preview or render processes send HTTPS requests to internal services.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an improper reference counting flaw on multisite deployments, allowing editors to delete other instances' attachment files. Because linkedRecords() counts only the local faqattachment table, deleting an attachment with shared md5 content makes File::delete() unlink the shared blob, destroying another instance's files.

BISHENG before 3.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to impersonate administrators by abusing a hard-coded default jwt_secret used by AuthJwt. Attackers can forge an HS256 token offline naming user_id 1 with the admin role, send it as access_token_cookie, and gain full administrative access to users, workspaces, knowledge bases and workflows.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver because idf_escape() doubles backticks but does not escape backslashes in identifiers. Attackers can lure a logged-in user into opening a GET link with a column name ending in a backslash in columns, where, or order parameters, causing query text to be parsed as SQL.

Insufficient Session Expiration vulnerability in the Apache Iggy Go SDK. The TCP client method CreatePersonalAccessToken wrote the 32-bit expiry into the upper half of the 64-bit expiry field that the server reads. The server read a nonzero expiry as 2^32 times the requested value. A token created through the Go TCP client therefore stayed valid about four billion times longer than the caller asked for.

This issue affects Apache Iggy Go SDK: from 0.5.0 before 0.10.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Tokens that an earlier version created keep their long expiry on the server. Delete those tokens and create new ones.

Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File vulnerability in the Apache Iggy server. If Apache Iggy 0.9.0 started without IGGY_ROOT_USERNAME and IGGY_ROOT_PASSWORD, it generated a root password and wrote it to the server log file, which is enabled by default. The system snapshot command (GetSnapshot on the binary transports and POST /snapshot on HTTP) let a user with only the read_servers permission download the server log files. That user could read the generated root password and log in as root.

This issue affects Apache Iggy: 0.9.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.10.0, which fixes the issue. Version 0.10.0 never generates a root password, and the snapshot requires the manage_servers permission. If a 0.9.0 server generated its root password, change that password.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated group or user admins to remove rights they do not hold by submitting empty rights lists. Attackers can send an empty rightIds or userRights array to group/permissions or user/update-rights to wipe all rights of more-privileged groups or administrators.

Bludit through 3.22.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to modify the site logo by calling unprotected AJAX endpoints. Attackers with Author or Editor roles can send requests to logo-upload.php or logo-remove.php under /admin/ajax/ to replace the site logo with an uploaded image or delete it.

phpMyFAQ 4.1.0 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in POST /api/webauthn/prepare that creates accounts as active, bypassing manual activation and domain whitelisting. Anonymous attackers can obtain the freely issued CSRF token and register an activated account with an unverified email to access registered-user-only content and functions.

53AIHub before 0.5.5 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows remote unauthenticated attackers to reinitialize installed instances by calling the public POST /api/init endpoint. Attackers can reset an existing account's password, assign the top creator role, and obtain an access token to take over accounts and use admin-only API routes.

Pi-hole FTL is the core engine of the Pi-hole network-level advertisement and tracker blocker. From 6.0 until 6.7, CivetWeb permits unauthenticated clients to flood the WebUI login page and API invalid paths without connection or request-rate limits. Repeated requests can consume substantial CPU in request processing and session authentication, making the WebUI sluggish or unresponsive and potentially affecting the wider system and DNS service. Requests to selected invalid or redirecting paths also generate a log entry for each request, allowing network traffic to expand logs and exhaust constrained storage such as an SD card, while other request forms consume CPU without producing a corresponding request log. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.7.

Atomic Server is an open source headless CMS and real-time database. Prior to 0.40.3, unauthenticated requests to /bookmark can supply a url that server/src/plugins/bookmark.rs passes through fetch_data to fetch_body. Endpoint dispatch in lib/src/db.rs invokes the handler before check_read, and lib/src/client/helpers.rs previously checked only that the URL began with HTTP, without restricting loopback, private, link-local, DNS-rebinding, or redirect targets. The handler reflects fetched content in returned resource fields, making this a full-response server-side request forgery that can expose internal services and plain-GET cloud metadata. The short request timeout limits slow targets, and metadata services requiring a separate token request are outside the demonstrated GET-only path. This issue is fixed in version 0.40.3.

Servo is a lightweight, high-performance web rendering engine for embedding web technologies in applications. Prior to 0.3.0, a sandboxed iframe can use declarative refresh to auto-navigate because RefreshRedirectDue::invoke() in components/script/dom/document/document.rs does not enforce the sandboxed automatic-features flag. The bypass occurs with sandbox="", sandbox="allow-same-origin", sandbox="allow-forms", and sandbox="allow-same-origin allow-forms". Attacker-controlled framed content can replace itself without user action, enabling framed phishing, content replacement, redirect loops, and limited denial of service, but the issue does not by itself permit script execution or parent DOM access. This issue is fixed in version 0.3.0.

Doorkeeper is an OAuth 2 provider for Ruby on Rails / Grape. Prior to 5.9.1, Doorkeeper's OAuth token revocation flow does not correctly authorize revocation requests when public, non-confidential clients are used, allowing tokens to be revoked without correct authorization. This issue is fixed in version 5.9.1.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the ClaudeSqlPlugin, GeminiSqlPlugin, and OpenWebUiPlugin sendHeaders() handlers that run on the login page. Unauthenticated attackers can POST claude, gemini, or openwebui fields to relay arbitrary prompts using the operator's API key or bearer token, including to internal Open WebUI endpoints.

NLTK from 3.10.0 before 3.10.4 contains a symlink escape vulnerability in YCOECorpusReader that allows attackers to read files outside the corpus root by planting psd or pos directory symlinks. Attackers controlling a YCOE corpus can make parsed_sents() and tagged_words() return file content from other corpora or temporary files within the NLTK data sandbox.

WeGIA is a web manager for charitable institutions. Prior to 3.8.7, web/html/socio/sistema/atualiza_pagamentos.php performs payment-status database updates without checking whether the requester has an authenticated session. An unauthenticated remote requester can supply a payment identifier, payment date, and paid value to mark arbitrary payment records as paid or otherwise modify payment information, causing financial record corruption. This issue is fixed in version 3.8.7.

HtmlSanitizer is a .NET library for cleaning HTML fragments and documents from constructs that can lead to XSS attacks. Prior to 9.0.967 and 9.1.968-beta, HtmlSanitizer CSS style-declaration sanitization can process an attacker-controlled style attribute with quadratic cost because SanitizeStyleDeclaration repeatedly causes the complete declaration to be serialized while removing disallowed CSS properties. One unauthenticated request can occupy a synchronous application worker for seconds, and concurrent requests can saturate all workers and sustain denial of service. This issue is fixed in versions 9.0.967 and 9.1.968-beta.
JIT miscompilation in the JavaScript Engine: JIT component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 160, Firefox ESR 153.7, Thunderbird 160, and Thunderbird 153.7.

NLTK from 3.2.5 before 3.10.4 contains an algorithmic complexity vulnerability in TreebankWordTokenizer.span_tokenize that allows remote attackers to cause quadratic CPU consumption through repeated list.pop(0) calls. Attackers can submit long runs of double-quote characters to services span-tokenizing untrusted text, exhausting a CPU core and degrading availability.

phpMyFAQ 4.1.9 before 4.1.12 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-RC.2 contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid logins through differing POST /api/webauthn/prepare responses. Attackers can submit wordlists of usernames, reusing one unconsumed CSRF token without rate limiting, to discover administrator logins for password spraying and phishing.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Cozmoslabs TranslatePress translatepress-multilingual allows Stored XSS.This issue affects TranslatePress: from n/a through 3.3.9.
Memory overflow in NetScaler Push can lead to unpredictable or erroneous behavior or Denial of Service in Citrix NetScaler

Dell SupportAssist OS Recovery, versions prior to 5.5.16.3, contain an Insecure Inherited Permissions vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to unauthorized file operations with elevated privileges.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in TMS Amelia ameliabooking allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Amelia: from n/a through 2.4.14.

NLTK before 3.10.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in save_maxent_params() and load_maxent_params() that bypasses the pathsec filesystem restriction mechanism. Attackers who control the tab_dir argument can read or overwrite model parameter files outside permitted data roots, because the functions call Python's built-in open() directly.

The GLPI Inventory Plugin handles network discovery, inventory, software deployment, and data collection for GLPI agents. Prior to 1.6.8, the /b/deploy, /b/collect, and /b/esx agent API endpoints do not authenticate requests before processing Deploy, Collect, and ESX task operations. An unauthenticated remote attacker can enumerate jobs and manipulate their status through these endpoints, disclosing job information and interfering with task processing. This issue is fixed in version 1.6.8.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Knit Pay Knit Pay knit-pay allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Knit Pay: from n/a through 9.6.5.0.

Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in WPExperts All In One Login change-wp-admin-login allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects All In One Login: from n/a through 2.5.1.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the ClickHouse driver that allows remote attackers to log in to passwordless accounts without the configured defaultPasswordHash password. Attackers who know the name of a ClickHouse no_password account can submit any non-empty password, because connect() skips openPasswordless(), and obtain a session with that account's rights.

NocoDB before 2026.06.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the profile update handler in users.service.ts, which returns the stored user record without passing it through the user-serialization filter, exposing the bcrypt password hash, salt, and session token counter. Attackers holding a stolen or hijacked session can update the profile to retrieve that account's password hash and salt for offline cracking.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Igor Funa Ad Inserter ad-inserter allows Code Injection.This issue affects Ad Inserter: from n/a through 2.8.19.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP User Manager WP User Manager wp-user-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects WP User Manager: from n/a through 2.10.4.

NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve full OAuth client records by querying the public client lookup route in oauth.controller.ts. Attackers who know or guess a client identifier can obtain the registration access token to modify or delete registrations, plus the bcrypt client secret hash and owner's internal identifier.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wpmet ElementsKit Elementor addons Lite elementskit-lite allows Stored XSS.This issue affects ElementsKit Elementor addons Lite: from n/a through 4.1.0.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows remote attackers to inject SQL by supplying crafted IN and NOT IN search values that process_length() passes unescaped. Attackers can send a logged-in user a cross-site GET link using a backslash-escaped apostrophe to run blind SQL with that user's database rights on PostgreSQL, SQLite, MS SQL, Oracle, or MySQL in NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES mode.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons bdthemes-element-pack-lite allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Element Pack Elementor Addons: from n/a through 10.0.5.

NocoDB from 2026.05.2 before 2026.07.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows Editor-role users to fetch internal URLs because data import reused the webhook internal-network exemption. When NC_ALLOW_LOCAL_HOOKS or NC_WEBHOOK_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK is set, attackers can request internal services via URLs ending in CSV or spreadsheet extensions and read the responses.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains a filter injection vulnerability in its MongoDB driver that allows attackers to affect other documents by embedding ' AND ' or ') OR (' delimiters in a string _id or searched value. Attackers who can store a crafted document can cause a victim's delete or edit to match unintended documents, deleting the entire collection or modifying another document.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a race condition in refresh-token rotation that allows attackers to reuse tokens because UserRefreshToken.ts never checks the affected-row count. Attackers holding a captured refresh token can present it concurrently with the legitimate user to obtain a valid authenticated session, and no reuse event is recorded.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in TMS Amelia ameliabooking allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Amelia: from n/a through 2.4.14.

AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in OtpLoginPlugin that allows attackers knowing the database password to skip TOTP verification by abusing the permanent-login cookie. Attackers can submit a login with a wrong OTP and permanent=1 to obtain a neo_permanent cookie, then replay it to gain full authenticated database access.

Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Code Injection.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.4.

ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in oauth-token.service.ts that treats PKCE as a substitute for confidential client authentication, skipping client secret verification when omitted. Attackers holding a captured authorization code and PKCE verifier can mint access tokens and 60-day refresh tokens for a confidential client without knowing its secret.

In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI relies on a world-writable /tmp file unless XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is set, or localhost TCP port 10010, allowing RXAPI communication by any local user, e.g., for injection of a macro that will be executed by a REXX script.

Vulnerability in the Oracle Access Manager product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Authentication Engine).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.1.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Access Manager.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle Access Manager, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle Access Manager accessible data as well as  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Access Manager accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a partial denial of service (partial DOS) of Oracle Access Manager. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:L).

Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in splashModeDeviceN8. Attackers can supply a PDF with an ICCBased image whose alternate is DeviceN, causing getDeviceNLine() to overflow the per-row buffer, crashing the renderer and corrupting heap memory.

NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass bulk row-count limits by using session authentication instead of API tokens. Attackers with Editor write permission on one table can submit hundreds of thousands of rows to v1 and v2 bulk write routes, exhausting database connections, CPU, and memory.

Umbraco CMS 17.0.0 before 17.7.1 and 18.0.0 before 18.2.1 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in Management API document version endpoints that skip per-document ContentPermissionByResource checks. Authenticated back-office users restricted to a start node can list and read document versions outside their tree by GUID, exposing unpublished values and altering prevent-cleanup flags.

fqterm before 0.9.11 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FQTermDecode that allows malicious servers to corrupt memory by sending CSI sequences with unbounded parameter indexes. Attackers controlling a telnet or SSH server, or intercepting cleartext telnet, can send over 30 semicolon-separated CSI parameters to write chosen 32-bit values past the decoder object on the heap.

WLA DX 9.7 through 10.7 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in parse_data_blocks() in wlalink/analyze.c that copies section namespaces without length checks. Attackers can supply a crafted object or library file with a namespace longer than 255 bytes or unterminated to overflow the 256-byte stack buffer when linked.

Cloud Commander (cloudcmd) before 19.21.4 contains an authentication bypass and path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to rename files by sending PUT /rename requests handled before authentication middleware. Attackers can supply absolute or ../ paths in the from and to arrays to move any file the Node.js process can access outside the configured root, causing data loss or denial of service.

Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

A flaw was found in OpenShift Hive. The ClusterClaim controller assigns hive-claim-owner RBAC based on a user-controlled ClusterClaim.spec.namespace and only verifies ClusterPoolRef.ClaimName. A tenant can point a same-named claim at another tenant's ClusterDeployment and obtain get access to that cluster's admin kubeconfig and admin password secrets.

The Event Tickets with Ticket Scanner plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'code' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload persists through WooCommerce session data into order-item metadata and executes when rendered in the ticket scanner interface.

GNU Emacs 31.1 contains a code injection vulnerability in its handling of directory-local variables. A crafted .dir-locals.el can supply a (REGEXP FUNCTION t) entry in auto-mode-alist; when a matching file is opened, Emacs calls FUNCTION before set-auto-mode--dir-local-valid-p validates it, executing arbitrary Emacs Lisp with the privileges of the Emacs process. (Emacs 30.2 is unaffected.)

Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in Rymera Web Co Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce woo-product-feed-pro allows Path Traversal.This issue affects Product Feed PRO for WooCommerce: from n/a through 13.5.8.

The WP Delicious – Recipe Plugin for Food Bloggers (formerly Delicious Recipes) plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'details[].icon' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.10.11 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload bypasses wp_kses_post on save because Gutenberg serializes block attribute JSON with JSON_HEX_QUOT, encoding double-quotes as \u0022 so no raw quote or angle bracket appears in post_content; parse_blocks() restores the literal quote at render time, producing the HTML attribute breakout.
vp: wp delicious – recipe plugin for food bloggers (formerly delicious recipes)

cves.d: crw-server before 0.45.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to reach internal services by supplying an unvalidated baseUrl to the /v1/scrape endpoint. Attackers can set llmApiKey and request the summary format, making the server POST to loopback or private addresses and use returned warnings as a reachability oracle.

ThinkPHP 2.0 through 2.2 and 3.0 Lite mode contains an eval injection vulnerability in the Dispatcher PATH_INFO parsing, which uses preg_replace with the /e modifier and a double-quoted replacement. Unauthenticated attackers can send crafted requests to index.php with a malicious 's' parameter containing PHP expressions to execute arbitrary code on the server. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

openSIS 5.1 before 9.0 contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows authenticated users to include arbitrary files through the modname parameter of ajax.php. Attackers can prefix a payload with misc/ and use ../ directory traversal to read sensitive files like /etc/passwd or execute local scripts in the web server context. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 before 1.4.3.1 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to make arbitrary requests via the source[] parameter in /ueditor/jsp/controller.jsp?action=catchimage. Attackers can supply crafted URLs that the ImageHunter component fetches through url.openConnection() to reach internal services and bypass network restrictions. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-03.

Baidu UEditor 1.4.0 through 1.4.3.3 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in the catchimage action of /ueditor/net/controller.ashx that only validates the Content-Type header. Unauthenticated attackers can supply a source[] URL like x.jpg?.aspx to retain a malicious extension and write an executable .aspx file for remote code execution. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-17.

FineCMS versions 5.0.4 before 5.0.11 contain an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the data2 API action handled by list_tag in libraries/Template.php. Attackers can send GET requests to index.php?c=api&m=data2 with a valid auth hash and the param action=sql sql='...' to execute arbitrary SELECT queries and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

FineReport 8.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files through the resourcepath parameter of the /WebReport/ReportServer endpoint. Attackers can send GET requests with op=chart and cmd=get_geo_json to read sensitive files like privilege.xml and extract admin credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Chamilo LMS 1.11.10 before 1.11.16 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the searchOptionsFromTags function through the options parameter of extra_field.ajax.php. Attackers can send POST requests with a malicious JSON options array to inject SQL into the IN clause and extract database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-14.

Rocket.Chat versions 0.61.0 before 3.11.4, 3.12.x before 3.12.4 and 3.13.x before 3.13.2 contain a missing authorization vulnerability allowing unauthenticated attackers to read any room's messages via the livechat:loadHistory Meteor method. Attackers can mint a guest token through livechat:registerGuest and send POST requests to /api/v1/method.callAnon with a target rid parameter to retrieve message history without membership checks. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2025-02-13.

The Product Options and Price Calculation Formulas for WooCommerce – Uni CPO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'data' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.9.69 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with shop manager-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page.
vp: product options and price calculation formulas for woocommerce – uni cpo

cves.d: Zhongqing Naboo Education Cloud Platform builds through 2021-07-09 contain a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/TeacherQuery/SearchTeacherInSiteWithPagerRecords endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive teacher data. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to this endpoint to retrieve user names, login names, and admin ids from the JSON response. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-11-15.

OTOBO 10.0.1 before 10.0.13 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying arbitrary URLs to the ExternalURLJump action. Attackers can craft GET requests to /otobo/index.pl?Action=ExternalURLJump with a malicious URL parameter, which the ExternalURLJump.pm module redirects to without an allow-list check, enabling phishing attacks. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

CmsEasy 7.7.5_20210919 contains an unauthenticated SQL injection vulnerability in the execsql_action function at /?case=crossall&act=execsql that executes attacker-supplied queries decrypted with the hardcoded key 'cmseasy_sql'. Attackers can send a crafted 'sql' parameter to run arbitrary SQL and dump the admin username and password hash. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-22.

Synway SMG Gateway Management Software builds through 2022-03-15 contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files via the downfile parameter in /down.php. Attackers can send a multipart POST request to /down.php with a traversal path in downfile to retrieve sensitive files like /etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-20.

Reddit Top RSS through commit 5e38bfd contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the unescaped score GET parameter. Attackers can craft links with a score value that closes the input value attribute in html.php, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

JoomBri Careers 3.3.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the 'keyword' parameter of the /for-jobseekers/search-jobs endpoint in com_jbcareers. Attackers can craft malicious URLs using an attribute-breakout payload with onfocus and autofocus to execute arbitrary JavaScript and steal session tokens or credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the console article update API that allows authenticated authors to inject SQL through unvalidated JSON property names. Attackers can send a PUT request to /console/article/ with crafted property names used as UPDATE column names, then read query results back through the updated article.

Tiki Wiki CMS Groupware 12.12 through 12.14, 15.5 before 18.10, 19.0 before 21.9, 22.0 before 24.3, and 25.0 contain a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the objectId parameter of tiki-ajax_services.php. Attackers can send a crafted GET request with the comment controller and list action to execute arbitrary JavaScript and steal session tokens or credentials. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

Nuxt 3.0.0 before 3.4.2 contains a semi-arbitrary file read vulnerability in the vite-node dev server middleware that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by supplying an absolute path as the moduleId. Attackers can send GET requests to /__nuxt_vite_node__/module/ with an absolute file path to read sensitive system files. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-19.

LiveBOS builds through 2023-08-16 contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files via the imgName parameter in /feed/ShowImage.do using a ';.js.jsp' suffix bypass. Attackers can send crafted GET requests with directory traversal sequences in imgName to read system files such as /etc/passwd. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-30.

phpLDAPadmin 1.1.0 before 1.2.5 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the dn parameter of cmd.php?cmd=template_engine. Attackers can supply an unparseable dn value that pretty_print_dn returns unescaped in the 'No such entry' error, executing JavaScript in victims' browsers. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2023-10-23.

Azon Dominator releases through 2024-06-03 contain an SQL injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to manipulate database queries through the cid parameter in /fetch_products.php. Attackers can send crafted POST requests with boolean-based or time-based blind payloads to extract sensitive database information. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-07-30.

AnyShare builds through 2024-11 contain a missing authentication vulnerability in the /api/ShareMgnt/Usrm_GetAllUsers endpoint that exposes user records including password fields. Attackers can send unauthenticated POST requests with a [start,limit] body to retrieve usernames, passwords, and department information for all users. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2024-12-25.
vendors: shanghai aishu information technology co., ltd.
vp: shanghai aishu information technology co., ltd.

cves.d: LimeSurvey 6.5.0 before 6.16.11 contains an open redirect vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect users by supplying arbitrary values to the url parameter. Attackers can send crafted GET requests to index.php?r=editorLink, where EditorLinkController concatenates url and route unvalidated, redirecting victims to attacker-controlled sites for phishing. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-03-20.

cPanel & WHM 11.134.0.13 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject scripts through the mpidentity parameter of /mailman/listinfo. Attackers can send crafted requests with a script-context breakout payload in mpidentity to execute arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's browser. Exploitation evidence was first observed by the Shadowserver Foundation on 2026-06-08.

The Orbit Fox: Duplicate Page, Menu Icons, SVG Support, Cookie Notice, Custom Fonts & More plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'title (post_title)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.13 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The exploit is further enabled by wptexturize deliberately skipping texturization of content inside <code> elements and the default WordPress kses allow-list preserving <code> tags and raw double quotes on save, allowing a crafted title attribute breakout payload to survive storage and the the_title filter chain intact.
vp: orbit fox: duplicate page, menu icons, svg support, cookie notice, custom fonts & more

cves.d: The SchemaEngine AI – AI Schema Markup, Reviews & Rich Snippets for SEO plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content/excerpt (REST wp/v2/posts) → stored in post_content/post_excerpt' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.1.3 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. A Contributor's entity-encoded payload survives save-time wp_kses filtering verbatim and is only decoded into raw script tags at render time via html_entity_decode(), meaning the injected script executes for every visitor — including authenticated Administrators — once an Editor publishes the post through the standard Contributor workflow.
vp: schemaengine ai – ai schema markup, reviews & rich snippets for seo

cves.d: The Coder VS Code extension opens Coder workspaces in VS Code with a single click. From 0.1.20 until 1.14.6, a malicious repository can provide .vscode/settings.json values for security-sensitive Coder settings because the extension permits workspace and folder scope to override those settings. Values such as coder.headerCommand and coder.tlsCertRefreshCommand are later executed as shell commands, while other affected settings can redirect the Coder CLI binary or download source, inject CLI or SSH flags, replace TLS material, disable TLS verification, or change identity and credential-storage behavior. A victim with the extension installed must open the malicious workspace or repository; when the extension activates, attacker-controlled commands can run with the victim user's privileges. The issue also affects untrusted workspaces because the extension declares untrusted-workspace support without preventing consumption of the workspace-controlled settings. This issue is fixed in version 1.14.6.

The Flexible PDF Invoices for WooCommerce & WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'billing_address.first_name / extensions.wpdesk-flexible-invoices-checkout._billing_vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 7.1.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Execution requires an administrator to open the invoice edit page for the attacker's order and interact with (e.g., type into or trigger a change/keyup event on) a field in the customer metabox, at which point the payload stored in billing fields such as first_name or _billing_vat_number is decoded from its entity-escaped input value and passed unsanitized to jQuery .html(). Successful exploitation additionally requires an action by an administrator — the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability on their own.
vp: flexible pdf invoices for woocommerce & wordpress

cves.d: OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. In 7.260722.0 and earlier, a user with the SETTINGS_SETCUSTOMIZATION capability can configure a webhook notifier with an arbitrary destination URL and invoke notifierTest to make the OpenCTI server send the request immediately. The request can target internal services or cloud metadata endpoints that are reachable from the server, enabling server-side request forgery without waiting for a notifier event. No fixed release is verified by the available evidence; later releases remain unclassified.

OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260706.0, the logsWorkerConfig GraphQL query is authorized with the broad CONNECTORAPI capability and returns Elasticsearch connection details including elasticsearch_username, elasticsearch_password, elasticsearch_api_key, the URL, index, proxy, and TLS-verification setting. A holder of any connector API bearer token can retrieve this credential material. If the returned credentials are valid and Elasticsearch is reachable, the caller can directly read, modify, or delete OpenCTI indices and audit history outside application-layer role, marking, organization, and audit controls, with the practical impact bounded by the credentials' privileges and network reachability. This issue is fixed in version 7.260706.0.

OpenCTI is an open source platform for managing cyber threat intelligence knowledge and observables. Prior to 7.260428.0, the token GraphQL mutation used for primary login has no endpoint-specific rate limit, while the global Express limiter defaults to permitting 10,000 requests in a one-second window. An unauthenticated remote attacker can make password guesses at network speed against a chosen user account and, if a credential is recovered, access the account's threat-intelligence data and permitted operations. This issue is fixed in version 7.260428.0.

VB-Audio VB-CABLE before 3.5.2.0 contains out-of-bounds read and write vulnerabilities in the vbaudio_cable64_win10.sys kernel streaming driver's KSPROPSETID_Audio MUTE, VOLUMELEVEL, and PEAKMETER2 property handlers that allow a local standard user to supply an all-channels sentinel value improperly used as a loop terminator or array index instead of being bounds-checked. Attackers can exploit the accessible low-integrity KS filter device object to write attacker-controlled values sequentially into kernel memory, corrupting kernel globals and object pointers, or read past an array boundary to leak kernel memory, resulting in local privilege escalation or denial of service via a kernel bug check.

containerd is an open-source container runtime. From 2.2.0 until 2.2.10, 2.3.7, and 2.4.2, image manifest processing through the transfer service can encounter a child descriptor containing the io.containerd.manifest.subject annotation and a malformed digest. Pulling or importing such an image, including through a default CRI PullImage request, can trigger an unrecovered panic and crash the containerd daemon. In Kubernetes, kubelet retries can repeatedly trigger the crash and disrupt container operations on the worker node. This issue is fixed in versions 2.2.10, 2.3.7, and 2.4.2.

qbee-agent is the device agent component of the qbee.io IoT device management platform. Prior to 2026.27, the privileged createFile helper followed attacker-controlled symbolic links during file creation. A local unprivileged user whose account is managed by the SSH Keys bundle could replace ~/.ssh with a link to /root/.ssh, causing the agent to write an authorized key for root. On systems using RAUC download mode with ineffective kernel symlink protection, the predictable /tmp/.bundle.raucb.part path could be linked to a system file and then overwritten or truncated during an update. A file-distribution destination beneath an attacker-controlled directory could similarly redirect the partial-download path so the agent changed ownership of a sensitive file. These vectors could result in root privilege escalation, arbitrary file modification, or denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 2026.27.

The Dokan: AI Powered WooCommerce Multivendor Marketplace Solution – Build Your Own Amazon, eBay, Etsy plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authorization Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.3. The vulnerability exists because the `matches_mcp_endpoint()` function applies an unanchored regular expression (`#/(?:woocommerce|dokan)/mcp(?:/|$)#`) against the entire `REQUEST_URI` including the query string, meaning any request that contains the literal substring `/dokan/mcp/` or `/woocommerce/mcp/` anywhere in its URI — including inside a query parameter value — is incorrectly treated as a trusted internal MCP context, causing `scope_product_permissions()` to unconditionally return `true` on WooCommerce's `woocommerce_rest_check_permissions` filter regardless of whether the caller is authenticated. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read full authenticated WooCommerce REST product records for any published product — including private underscore-prefixed meta, purchase notes, downloadable file URLs for paid digital products, catalog-hidden products, and edit-context representations — across the `/wc/v1`, `/wc/v2`, `/wc/v3`, and `/wc-analytics` REST namespaces. The bypass is triggered by appending a query parameter whose value contains the literal string `/dokan/mcp/` to any WooCommerce REST product endpoint (e.g., `/wp-json/wc/v3/products/{id}?x=/dokan/mcp/`); note that percent-encoding the slashes prevents the bypass, as the unencoded literal slash characters are required for the regex to match.

cves.d: An issue in PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System (ELMS) Version 2.1 allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges via the password recovery functionality

Guard Core is an API security core engine for the FastAPI-Guard, FlaskAPI Guard, and DjAPI Guard adapters. From 3.5.0 until 3.13.0, built-in penetration-detection patterns in guard_core/handlers/suspatterns_handler.py execute through a direct pattern.search(content) call instead of the timeout-protected create_safe_matcher() path used for custom patterns. The built-in template-injection detector contains an unbounded expression with quadratic behavior when scanning repeated opening braces. Because penetration detection and enhanced mode are enabled by a stock SecurityConfig, an unauthenticated request can block the shared asyncio event loop, affecting all application endpoints. The triggering input does not produce a detection match, so the request can complete without incrementing ban counters or being recorded as suspicious. This issue is fixed in version 3.13.0.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an IP address spoofing vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge their recorded source IP by supplying X-Forwarded-For headers, because Express trust proxy is enabled unconditionally. Attackers can write arbitrary source addresses into audit and request logs to mislead investigations and evade the per-address public API rate limiter.

Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. Prior to 15.5.29 and 16.4.5, self-hosted Next.js App Router route handlers and the fetch cache that return a fetched upstream response unchanged can emit a response whose declared framing does not match the body actually sent. When the application is behind an HTTP/1.1 reverse proxy that permits pipelined response queueing, a crafted upstream response can desynchronize responses between clients. The resulting desynchronization can inject a response into another client's queue or disclose another client's response. This issue is fixed in versions 16.4.5 and 15.5.29.

Receiving crafted out-of-sequence DTLS handshake fragments may cause OpenSSL to allocate a full message-length reassembly buffer for each buffered message, so a small amount of wire data consumes a large amount of memory.

The Image Source Control Lite – Show Image Credits and Captions plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'meta[isc_image_licence]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.14.0 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The licence display feature must be enabled in the plugin settings (enable_licences option), which is a standard configuration for sites using the licence-attribution functionality.
